args: B=""; HF=""; for F in "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/.claude/eugo-mcp-headers.txt" "$HOME/.config/eugo/mcp-headers.txt"; do if [ -z "$B" ] && [ -f "$F" ]; then B="$(sed -n 's/^Authorization: *Bearer *//p' "$F" | head -n 1)"; HF="$F"; fi; done; [ -n "$B" ] || B="$EUGO_MCP_TOKEN"; if docker exec eugo-kb-tools true >/dev/null 2>&1; then if [ -n "$B" ]; then E="${XDG_RUNTIME_DIR:-$HOME/.config/eugo}/eugo-mcp-stdio.env"; mkdir -p "$(dirname "$E")" 2>/dev/null; (umask 077; printf 'EUGO_MCP_BEARER=%s\n' "$B" > "$E") 2>/dev/null && exec docker exec -i --env-file "$E" eugo-kb-tools /opt/miniforge3/envs/eugo_kb/bin/eugo-mcp; fi; exec docker exec -i eugo-kb-tools /opt/miniforge3/envs/eugo_kb/bin/eugo-mcp; fi; if [ -n "$HF" ]; then exec npx -y mcp-remote@0.8.2 https://kb.eugo.io:8443/mcp --header-file "$HF"; fi; exec npx -y mcp-remote@0.8.2 https://kb.eugo.io:8443/mcp --header 'Authorization: Bearer ${EUGO_MCP_TOKEN}'
